labelled_by: Hand-labelled ground truth for the eval harness. Quotes are verbatim substrings of the transcripts.

quotes.quote: each one is an empty 45-minute slot I can't fill at the last minute.
The therapist sits there, unpaid time for the clinic.
when someone doesn't come I'm not earning anything for that hour but I still pay the room rent.
I calculated last year that missed appointments cost us around 18,000 euros.

pain_points.label: Manual reminder calls take a lot of staff time

quotes.quote: It takes her most of the afternoon, and half the time she gets voicemail.
I make about forty reminder calls every afternoon.

pain_points.label: Cancelled slots are hard to refill from a waiting list

quotes.quote: by the time we find someone on the list who can come in, the slot has passed.
When someone cancels, I want the slot offered to the waiting list automatically.

pain_points.label: Switching practice software is costly and feared

quotes.quote: I lost a weekend to exporting and re-importing patient files.
Changing software means retraining everyone and moving all the records.

H1.why: 4 of 5 describe no-shows as a major cost (C-05 quantifies 18,000 EUR/year); C-04 is the exception (3 percent no-shows).

H2.why: Younger and sports patients book online (C-02, C-03, C-04); older patients prefer the phone (C-01, C-05).

H3.why: Every clinic resists switching; they would only adopt something that works alongside current software.

H4.why: Cancellation fees are not discussed in any interview.

stances_note: Per-interview stance on each hypothesis with verbatim quotes. Interviews not listed did not discuss it.

H2.question: How did your last ten patients book their appointment?
H2.purpose: Get a real split between phone and online booking for this clinic.
H2.bias_check: Asks about a specific past event, so the answer is a fact, not a prediction.
follow_ups: Who were the ones who called?

H2.question: When a patient wants to book outside opening hours, what happens today?
H2.purpose: Find demand for self-booking without asking for an opinion.
H2.bias_check: Asks about current behaviour, not whether online booking is wanted.

H4.question: What happens today when a patient cancels the evening before?
H4.purpose: See whether cancellation fees exist or have been considered.
H4.bias_check: Does not mention fees, so it cannot plant the idea.
follow_ups: Have you ever charged for a late cancellation? What happened?

PP1.question: Tell me about the last empty slot you had because a patient did not come.
PP1.purpose: Understand the cost and frequency of no-shows in concrete terms.
PP1.bias_check: Asks about a specific past event, so the answer is a fact, not a prediction.
follow_ups: What did you do with that hour?

PP4.question: Tell me about the last time you changed a piece of software at the clinic.
PP4.purpose: Learn what switching costs in practice and who decides.
PP4.bias_check: Asks about a specific past event, so the answer is a fact, not a prediction.
follow_ups: Who was involved in the decision?

PP3.question: When a slot frees up at short notice, how do you try to fill it?
PP3.purpose: See the current backfill process and where it fails.
PP3.bias_check: Asks for the current process, not for interest in a feature.
